name: The Scalper
source:
A new game console has come out, but it's impossible to buy it. It seems that someone has bought huge stocks of it, in the name of some shady financial speculation. Things start to escalate when a rare, cursed game comes into play.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/the-scalper]itch.io[/url]]
